mapper.update: MERGE INTO PDA_DEVICE_ACTIVITY t USING (SELECT CAST(#{uniqueId} AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS UNIQUE_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.UNIQUE_ID = s.UNIQUE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.STORE_CD = #{storeCd}, t.USER_ID = #{userId}, t.LAST_ACTIVE_AT = SYSDATE, t.LOGOUT_AT = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UNIQUE_ID, STORE_CD, USER_ID, LAST_ACTIVE_AT) VALUES (#{uniqueId}, #{storeCd}, #{userId}, SYSDATE)
